title: Emo-LiveSync: Real-Time Universal Lip Synchronization with Explicit Emotion Control
title_zh: Emo-LiveSync：具有显式情感控制的实时通用唇形同步

paragraphs.en: Emo-LiveSync基于LivePortrait实现支持显式情感控制的实时高保真通用唇形同步。 Lip synchronization, the task of generating realistic lip movements synchronized with audio signals, is fundamental to applications such as film dubbing, virtual avatars, and digital content creation. Recent GAN-based methods offer computational efficiency but often lack visual fidelity, while diffusion-based approaches achieve high-quality results at the cost of substantial computational overhead. Moreover, most existing methods are limited to photo-realistic human faces, restricting their applicability to stylized characters and non-human entities. In this paper, we propose an efficient universal lip-sync video generation framework that achieves high-quality results without compromising computational efficiency. We build on LivePortrait, a warp-based portrait animation model, and introduce a training strategy that aligns audio signals to an implicit motion space by distilling knowledge from a pre-trained video-to-motion model. This enables real-time inference while maintaining high visual fidelity, and naturally generalizes to diverse stylistic characters beyond photo-realistic humans. Furthermore, we introduce an expressive control gate that enables explicit manipulation of emotional expressions for content enrichment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both visual quality and lip-sync accuracy while ensuring real-time inference.
paragraphs.zh: Emo-LiveSync 基于LivePortrait实现支持显式情感控制的实时高保真通用唇形同步。唇形同步是生成与音频信号同步的真实唇部运动的任务，是电影配音、虚拟形象和数字内容创作等应用的基础。 近期基于GAN的方法计算效率高，但往往缺乏视觉保真度，而基于扩散的方法虽然能取得高质量结果，却需要付出巨大的计算开销。 此外，大多数现有方法仅限于照片级真实感人脸，限制了其在风格化角色和非人类实体上的适用性。 本文提出了一种高效的通用唇形同步视频生成框架，在不牺牲计算效率的情况下实现高质量结果。 我们以基于形变的肖像动画模型LivePortrait为基础，引入一种训练策略，通过从预训练的视频到运动模型中蒸馏知识，将音频信号对齐到隐式运动空间。 这使得模型能够实时推理，同时保持高视觉保真度，并自然地泛化到照片级真实人类之外的多样风格化角色。 此外，我们引入了一个富有表现力的控制门，可以显式操纵情感表达以丰富内容。 大量实验表明，我们的方法在视觉质量和唇形同步精度上均达到了最先进的性能，同时保证了实时推理。
